trust_decision.summary: Whether a caller-supplied field name may be dispatched as a method on a Document (send/public_send/try) or must be resolved only to declared fields/associations/aliases or the raw attributes hash; decided (absent) at each in-memory read site, fixed by a new FieldReadable#read_field_value allowlist.

landing_point.why: The advisory summary names the 'atomic pop operation'; Document#pop does send(field) on a caller-supplied key. The published fix never touches this file: its sites are the in-memory aggregation/pluck code under lib/mongoid/contextual/.

fix_sites.entry_point: Criteria#avg / #aggregates on an embedded or in-memory criteria (Contextual::Memory)
Criteria#sum / #min / #max / #aggregates on an embedded or in-memory criteria
Criteria#pluck / #pick / #tally / #distinct (non-legacy) via retrieve_value_at_path, including dotted paths
Criteria#pluck with a dotted path on a localized field (send -> public_send)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: lib/mongoid/contextual/memory.rb:720-755 (retrieve_value_at_path, a private recursive path walker shared by pluck/pick/tally/distinct; per-segment dispatch at :737, so '_root.destroy' style paths reach it on later segments)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The report talks about aggregation/pop; pluck/tally go through a shared path walker that already special-cases associations via aliased_associations, so it looks like 'field lookup', not method dispatch, and the legacy distinct branch is behind a deprecated 7.x flag.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Reading must still resolve declared fields, field aliases, belongs_to association names (document, not FK), *_ids accessors, store_as names, localized *_translations readers and dynamic attributes; an over-broad fix that reads only attributes[] or rejects unknown names breaks pluck(:band), pluck(:preference_ids), pluck(:mood).

O6_input_shapes: private method name (exit) as well as public (destroy/delete/attributes)
association name, store_as name and *_ids accessor

O7_producer.where: Field/association declarations (lib/mongoid/fields/validators/macro.rb:49, lib/mongoid/association/relatable.rb:403) only validate declared names against Mongoid.destructive_fields; the read sites never consult them at the pinned commit.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Document#pop dispatches each caller-supplied key via send(field) after only database_field_name aliasing — the very operation the advisory names.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Atomic update operators are a write API whose keys are 'developer-chosen field names', and the published fix (and its tests) only touch query contexts.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: lib/mongoid/persistable/ vs lib/mongoid/contextual/ (different package from every fix site)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Document#pull and #pull_all dispatch the key via send(field).
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Same as pop: write-side atomic modifier, not named by the fix.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Document#push and #add_to_set dispatch the key via send(field) before falling back to attributes[field].
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Falls back to attributes[], so it looks like it already handles unknown names; same package as pop (also :53 for push).

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Contextual::Memory#distinct under Mongoid.legacy_pluck_distinct (set by load_defaults 7.x) still does doc.send(field); the fix's distinct test only exercises the non-legacy pluck branch.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Deprecated legacy flag scheduled for removal (lib/mongoid/warnings.rb:36), off by default (lib/mongoid/config.rb:119).
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file as a fix site, 650 lines away

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Reading the current value via send(field) instead of attributes[field] in inc/bit/mul.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Its neighbours pop/pull/push already read via send(field); a maintainer wanting getter semantics (typecasting) would copy that idiom.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A group_by/count_by-style in-memory helper reading doc.public_send(field) directly instead of retrieve_value_at_path.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: aggregate_by already used doc.public_send(field) for exactly this job before the fix.

O9_family: CWE-470 unsafe reflection / method-name dispatch (code-injection family)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Guard Document#pop (the named operation) with respond_to?/destructive_fields, or switch it to attributes[field], leaving the in-memory sum/avg/min/max/pluck/tally dispatch and legacy distinct open.

out_of_scope_notes: The 3 fix commits are release bundles also carrying unrelated security fixes: query-operator guard ($where/$function), in-memory regexp CPU budget, nested-attributes reparenting/id conversion, encryption config; only the FieldReadable part belongs to this advisory.
lib/mongoid/serializable.rb:111 serializable_hash does send(name) for names from options; not traced.
lib/mongoid/criteria.rb:503-512 method_missing forwards names to the class; developer-controlled call, not pursued.
unverified: Advisory/fix mismatch: the summary names the atomic pop operation, but no fix commit touches lib/mongoid/persistable/poppable.rb. Either the advisory text is mislabelled or the fix for pop is not in these commits; confirm before building.
Whether services: mongodb is strictly required: the in-memory specs call Band.create!, so the specs need a local mongod; offline_after_build assumes a local server binary is installed at build time.
present_in_latest for all O8 routes: no latest release was provided.
